turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you doing right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We've got a week off in spring and want somewhere warm, but not a twelve hour flight.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Lisbon, Seville or one of the Greek islands would all fit. Are you more in the mood for a city or a beach?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hang on, I'm going to chat with my friend for a bit. Just wait until I say I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Daniel, which box did you put the kettle in?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: The one that says kitchen. Or maybe the one that says misc.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There are like six that say misc.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Yeah, I got a bit lazy with the labels near the end.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you help me look? I really need a tea.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Start with the small ones. I'll check the ones by the door.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm back, sorry for the wait.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. You were deciding between a city trip and somewhere with a beach.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: City, definitely. I get bored lying on the sand.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then Lisbon is a great pick. Lots of walking, good food and day trips to the coast if you change your mind.
